children: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority issued regulations governing the development of the country's planned commodity exchange, the regulator said in a statement on Friday.
The planned exchange is part of President Prabowo Subianto's push to expand state control over the country's vast natural resources and their proceeds.
OJK also issued a separate regulation to transfer supervisory rule mineral and strategic commodity exchange from the Commodity Futures Trading Supervisory Agency to the OJK, they said
